name: Cinema Templates
intro: Cinema Templates in SmartVideo is a library of ready made cinematic templates, from short films and trailers to brand and ad films.

features.template-browser: Start in the template browser, a grid of cards with a thumbnail, name and description, grouped by category so you can pick the right structure.
features.quick-mode-vs-advanced: Quick Mode asks only the essential questions for your template. Switch to Advanced when you want extra fields and more control.
features.video-intent-panel: The video intent panel sets your creative direction once, including video type and aspect ratio, so you can reuse it across templates.
features.ai-enhancer: The AI enhancer switch is on by default. It expands your simple input into a richer cinematic prompt, so you get better wording with no extra effort.
features.media-sources-and-routing: Add a start or reference image, or a source video, to use your own media as the base. A badge shows which path your video will take.
features.scene-timeline-and-scene-builder: Video templates list their scenes in a Scene Timeline. Use Refresh to re-pick them, or add scenes yourself to shape the story.
features.editable-output-tabs: Under Output you can read and edit the enhanced prompt, scene beats, voiceover and negative prompt, so you can fine tune the wording first.
features.storyboard-hand-off: If you arrive from Storyboard Studio, a Storyboard Loaded banner shows, and your planned shots become the template scenes.

outro: Choose a template, answer a few questions, and Cinema Templates gives your next film a strong start.
